name: Warm-white and dim light can raise positive affect

direction.note: The studies compared 150 and 1500 lux, and warm-white and cool-white fluorescent lamps.

claim: Under warm-white light people chose more cooperative ways to solve a conflict and gave more time to help, and low light raised ratings of others in one study.
caveat: The authors say that the support for positive affect as the cause is only partial, so treat the cue as weak.

sources.title: Baron, Rea and Daniels 1992, Effects of indoor lighting on cognitive tasks and interpersonal behaviors, Motivation and Emotion 16(1)
